title: Create: Baby Chicken Frogports
description: Changes the Frogport model to the new baby chicken. Inspired by Foxy's mod for the Just Create SMP!
body:
Create: Baby Chicken Frogports

The baby chicken takes over Create.\ It loves packages and decided to replace the frogs. ![baby chicken forgport](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cd4f1a976912ce7e686f8270485b0c6b5ad5042.png) Inspired by the Just Create SMP where FoxyNoTail backported a player eating baby shicken…. This one just sends and eats packages tho :D
**** This resource pack changes the model of the frogport, therefore if any other mod uses the default model as a parent it also gets changed.\ Currently there is "support" for the _Create: Vibrant Vaults_ addon, to ensure it retains the standard frogport.
